description: Source code for SparkConnectStatement class implementing JDBC Statement interface for Spark SQL connect client.

classes.name: SparkConnectStatement
classes.description: Implementation of JDBC Statement for Spark Connect client, managing query execution, result sets, and statement lifecycle.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the statement, interrupts ongoing operation if any, and releases resources.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes SQL query and returns ResultSet if available.

methods.name: executeUpdate
methods.description: Executes SQL update and returns update count.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes SQL statement, determines if result set is produced.

methods.name: setMaxRows
methods.description: Sets maximum number of rows for result.

methods.name: getUpdateCount
methods.description: Returns number of affected rows, or -1 if result set is present.
